description: He wears a long ivory woven tunic with dark brown and muted gold geometric embroidery around the round slit neckline, down the front and at the long sleeve cuffs and lower hem. A heavy burgundy-brown patterned mantle crosses his chest and falls from the shoulder, secured by a round bronze brooch. A brown leather belt with a metal buckle and hanging tab encircles the waist. Brown trousers and dark brown knee-high leather boots cover the legs; his bare hands are clasped in front.
